content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks|COREMERCH guide to complete]] set of tools that allows creators to sell their digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and templates, without relying on third-party platforms. This stack includes hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing, all of which are designed to work seamlessly together. By using a sovereign stack, creators can maintain full ownership and control over their digital products and sales, eliminating the need for intermediaries and their associated fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack is built around free and open-source technologies, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. For payment processing, NOWPayments is used, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a flat fee of 0.5%. This architecture allows for automatic crypto payment verification, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, making it an attractive solution for digital creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in countries where conventional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable. By using a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can sell their products without worrying about platform fees or restrictions, and maintain full control over their sales and customer data. This is particularly useful for creators who sell digital products, such as ebooks, courses, templates, and software, and want to reach a global audience without being held back by infrastructure limitations.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks empower creators to sell their products without relying on restrictive platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of a sovereign digital commerce stack include hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Each of these components is carefully selected to work seamlessly together, ensuring a smooth and efficient sales process. For example, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide fast and reliable hosting, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic and automate tasks. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders and customer data, and NOWPayments handles payment processing, making it easy for creators to manage their sales and customer interactions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by selecting the components that best fit their needs. They can choose from a range of free and open-source technologies, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and configure them to work together. They can also use pre-built templates and blueprints, such as those included in the Complete Builder Kit, to streamline the deployment process and get started quickly. By following a step-by-step guide and using the right tools, creators can have a fully functional digital commerce stack up and running in no time, and start selling their products to a global audience.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use a sovereign digital commerce stack that includes hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. This stack can be deployed using free and open-source technologies, such as GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, and can be customized to meet the specific needs of the creator. By using a sovereign stack, creators can maintain full ownership and control over their digital products and sales, and avoid platform fees and restrictions.
NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5%, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee.

This kit is available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and provides a step-by-step guide to deploying a fully functional digital commerce stack. With the Complete Builder Kit, creators can save time and effort, and focus on selling their products to a global audience.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: select a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script; set up order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets; configure file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2; integrate payment processing using NOWPayments; and test and deploy the stack. By following these steps, creators can have a fully functional digital commerce stack up and running in no time, and start selling their products to a global audience. Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments?
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5%, making it a more cost-effective solution for digital creators.
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack to sell physical products?
While a sovereign digital commerce stack is designed for digital products, it can be modified to accommodate physical products, but may require additional components and customization.
How do I handle customer support with a sovereign digital commerce stack?
Creators can handle customer support using email or other communication channels, and can also use automation tools to streamline support tasks and improve response times.
Is a sovereign digital commerce stack secure?
Yes, a sovereign digital commerce stack can be highly secure, as it uses free and open-source technologies and does not rely on third-party platforms or intermediaries.
Can I customize a sovereign digital commerce stack to fit my brand?
Yes, a sovereign digital commerce stack can be fully customized to fit a creator's brand and style, using CSS, HTML, and other design tools.
